cytoscape.min.js — Cytoscape.js 3.30.2
Source: https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.30.2/dist/cytoscape.min.js
Vendored: 2026-08-11
License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2016-2024, The Cytoscape Consortium)

Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the published site is self-contained and
makes no third-party requests at page load. Used by both the published network
diagram and the portal's per-character diagram.

To update: replace the file from the same URL with a new version number, and
update this file. There is no build step.
